headline: Xbox First COO Helen Chiang Departs Microsoft After Three Months
summary: Helen Chiang is leaving Microsoft just three months after assuming the newly created role of chief operating officer for Xbox, according to an internal memo.
why: High-level executive departures at major technology conglomerates can signal organizational shifts or strategic realignment within business units.

impacts.name: Microsoft
impacts.why: Sudden leadership changes in a major gaming division can affect execution of strategic hardware and software plans.
